verses.original: חֲזוֹן֙ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֔וֹץ חָזָ֔ה בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֧הוּ יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zō·wn ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ ḥā·zāh bî·mê ‘uz·zî·yā·hū yō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḥāz yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: [This is] the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah Jotham Ahaz and Hezekiah kings of Judah

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְהַאֲזִ֣ינִי אֶ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּ֑ר גִּדַּ֣לְתִּי בָּנִים֙ וְרוֹמַ֔מְתִּי וְהֵ֖ם פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū šā·ma·yim wə·ha·’ă·zî·nî ’e·reṣ kî Yah·weh dib·bêr gid·dal·tî bā·nîm wə·rō·w·mam·tî wə·hêm pā·šə·‘ū ḇî
verses.literal: Listen O heavens and give ear O earth for the LORD has spoken I have raised children and brought them up but they have rebelled against Me

verses.original: שׁוֹר֙ יָדַ֥ע קֹנֵ֔הוּ וַחֲמ֖וֹר בְּעָלָ֑יו אֵב֣וּס יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע עַמִּ֖י לֹ֥א הִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: šō·wr yā·ḏa‘ qō·nê·hū wa·ḥă·mō·wr bə·‘ā·lāw ’ê·ḇūs yiś·rā·’êl lō yā·ḏa‘ ‘am·mî lō hiṯ·bō·w·nān
verses.literal: The ox knows its owner and the donkey its master’s manger but Israel does not know My people do not understand

verses.original: ה֣וֹי׀ חֹטֵ֗א גּ֣וֹי עַ֚ם כֶּ֣בֶד עָוֺ֔ן זֶ֣רַע מְרֵעִ֔ים בָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֑ים עָזְב֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה נִֽאֲצ֛וּ אֶת־ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נָזֹ֥רוּ אָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ḥō·ṭê gō·w ‘am ke·ḇeḏ ‘ā·wōn ze·ra‘ mə·rê·‘îm bā·nîm maš·ḥî·ṯîm ‘ā·zə·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ni·’ă·ṣū ’eṯ- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl nā·zō·rū ’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: Alas O sinful nation a people laden with iniquity a brood of evildoers children who act corruptly They have forsaken - the LORD they have despised - the Holy One of Israel [and] turned their backs on Him

verses.original: עַ֣ל מֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד תֻכּ֛וּ תּוֹסִ֣יפוּ סָרָ֑ה רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל־ לָחֳלִ֔י וְכָל־ לֵבָ֖ב דַּוָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al meh ‘ō·wḏ ṯuk·kū tō·w·sî·p̄ū sā·rāh rōš kāl- lā·ḥo·lî wə·ḵāl lê·ḇāḇ daw·wāy
verses.literal: Why . . . do you want more beatings Why do you keep rebelling Your head has a massive wound and your whole heart is afflicted

verses.original: מִכַּף־ רֶ֤גֶל וְעַד־ רֹאשׁ֙ אֵֽין־ בּ֣וֹ מְתֹ֔ם פֶּ֥צַע וְחַבּוּרָ֖ה טְרִיָּ֑ה וּמַכָּ֣ה לֹא־ זֹ֙רוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א חֻבָּ֔שׁוּ וְלֹ֥א רֻכְּכָ֖ה בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kap̄- re·ḡel wə·‘aḏ- rōš ’ên- bōw mə·ṯōm pe·ṣa‘ wə·ḥab·bū·rāh ṭə·rî·yāh ū·mak·kāh lō- zō·rū wə·lō ḥub·bā·šū wə·lō ruk·kə·ḵāh baš·šā·men
verses.literal: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head [there is] no soundness only wounds and welts and festering sores neither cleansed nor bandaged nor soothed with oil

verses.original: אַרְצְכֶ֣ם שְׁמָמָ֔ה עָרֵיכֶ֖ם שְׂרֻפ֣וֹת אֵ֑שׁ זָרִים֙ אֹכְלִ֣ים אֹתָ֔הּ אַדְמַתְכֶ֗ם לְנֶגְדְּכֶם֙ וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֥ת זָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·ṣə·ḵem šə·mā·māh ‘ā·rê·ḵem śə·ru·p̄ō·wṯ ’êš zā·rîm ’ō·ḵə·lîm ’ō·ṯāh ’aḏ·maṯ·ḵem lə·neḡ·də·ḵem ū·šə·mā·māh kə·mah·pê·ḵaṯ zā·rîm
verses.literal: Your land is desolate your cities [are] burned with fire Foreigners devour - your fields before you a desolation demolished by strangers

verses.original: בַת־ צִיּ֖וֹן וְנוֹתְרָ֥ה כְּסֻכָּ֣ה בְכָ֑רֶם כִּמְלוּנָ֥ה בְמִקְשָׁ֖ה כְּעִ֥יר נְצוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn wə·nō·wṯ·rāh kə·suk·kāh ḇə·ḵā·rem kim·lū·nāh ḇə·miq·šāh kə·‘îr nə·ṣū·rāh
verses.literal: And the Daughter of Zion is abandoned like a shelter in a vineyard like a shack in a cucumber field like a city besieged

verses.original: לוּלֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הוֹתִ֥יר לָ֛נוּ כִּמְעָ֑ט שָׂרִ֖יד הָיִ֔ינוּ כִּסְדֹ֣ם דָּמִֽינוּ׃ס לַעֲמֹרָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: lū·lê Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hō·w·ṯîr lā·nū kim·‘āṭ śā·rîḏ hā·yî·nū kis·ḏōm dā·mî·nū la·‘ă·mō·rāh
verses.literal: Unless the LORD of Hosts had left us a few survivors we would have become like Sodom we would have resembled Gomorrah

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh qə·ṣî·nê sə·ḏōm ha·’ă·zî·nū tō·w·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘am ‘ă·mō·rāh
verses.literal: Hear the word of the LORD you rulers of Sodom listen to the instruction of our God you people of Gomorrah

verses.original: לָמָּה־ לִּ֤י רֹב־ זִבְחֵיכֶם֙ יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׂבַ֛עְתִּי עֹל֥וֹת אֵילִ֖ים וְחֵ֣לֶב מְרִיאִ֑ים לֹ֥א חָפָֽצְתִּי׃ וְדַ֨ם פָּרִ֧ים וּכְבָשִׂ֛ים וְעַתּוּדִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- lî rōḇ- ziḇ·ḥê·ḵem yō·mar Yah·weh śā·ḇa‘·tî ‘ō·lō·wṯ ’ê·lîm wə·ḥê·leḇ mə·rî·’îm lō ḥā·p̄ā·ṣə·tî wə·ḏam pā·rîm ū·ḵə·ḇā·śîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm
verses.literal: What [good] to Me [is] your multitude of sacrifices says the LORD I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle vvv I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats

verses.original: כִּ֣י תָבֹ֔אוּ לֵרָא֖וֹת פָּנָ֑י מִי־ בִקֵּ֥שׁ זֹ֛את מִיֶּדְכֶ֖ם רְמֹ֥ס חֲצֵרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯā·ḇō·’ū lê·rā·’ō·wṯ pā·nāy mî- ḇiq·qêš zōṯ mî·yeḏ·ḵem rə·mōs ḥă·ṣê·rāy
verses.literal: When you come to appear before Me who has required this of you this trampling of My courts

verses.original: הָבִיא֙ שָׁ֔וְא מִנְחַת־ לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֗יפוּ קְטֹ֧רֶת תּוֹעֵבָ֛ה הִ֖יא לִ֑י חֹ֤דֶשׁ וְשַׁבָּת֙ קְרֹ֣א מִקְרָ֔א לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל אָ֖וֶן וַעֲצָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇî šāw min·ḥaṯ- lō ṯō·w·sî·p̄ū qə·ṭō·reṯ tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh hî lî ḥō·ḏeš wə·šab·bāṯ qə·rō miq·rā lō- ’ū·ḵal ’ā·wen wa·‘ă·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Bring your worthless offerings no more your incense is detestable . . . to Me New Moons Sabbaths and convocations . . . I cannot endure iniquity in a solemn assembly

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֔י שָׂנְאָ֣ה חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֤ם וּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֙ הָי֥וּ לָטֹ֑רַח עָלַ֖י נִלְאֵ֖יתִי נְשֹֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî śā·nə·’āh ḥā·ḏə·šê·ḵem ū·mō·w·‘ă·ḏê·ḵem hā·yū lā·ṭō·raḥ ‘ā·lay nil·’ê·ṯî nə·śō
verses.literal: I hate your New Moons and your appointed feasts They have become a burden to Me I am weary of bearing them

verses.original: וּבְפָרִשְׂכֶ֣ם כַּפֵּיכֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַי֙ מִכֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־ תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה אֵינֶ֣נִּי שֹׁמֵ֑עַ יְדֵיכֶ֖ם מָלֵֽאוּ׃ דָּמִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·p̄ā·riś·ḵem kap·pê·ḵem ’a‘·lîm ‘ê·nay mik·kem gam kî- ṯar·bū ṯə·p̄il·lāh ’ê·nen·nî šō·mê·a‘ yə·ḏê·ḵem mā·lê·’ū dā·mîm
verses.literal: When you spread out your hands in prayer I will hide My eyes from you even though you multiply your prayers I will not listen Your hands are covered with blood

verses.original: רַחֲצוּ֙ הִזַּכּ֔וּ הָסִ֛ירוּ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י חִדְל֖וּ הָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ra·ḥă·ṣū hiz·zak·kū hā·sî·rū rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·ḵem min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāy ḥiḏ·lū hā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: Wash and cleanse yourselves Remove your evil deeds from My sight Stop doing evil

verses.original: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ שִׁפְט֣וּ יָת֔וֹם רִ֖יבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lim·ḏū hê·ṭêḇ dir·šū miš·pāṭ ’aš·šə·rū ḥā·mō·wṣ šip̄·ṭū yā·ṯō·wm rî·ḇū ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: Learn to do right seek justice [and] correct the oppressor Defend the fatherless [and] plead the case of the widow

verses.original: לְכוּ־ נָ֛א וְנִוָּֽכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־ חֲטָאֵיכֶ֤ם יִֽהְי֨וּ כַּשָּׁנִים֙ יַלְבִּ֔ינוּ כַּשֶּׁ֣לֶג אִם־ יַאְדִּ֥ימוּ כַתּוֹלָ֖ע יִהְיֽוּ׃ כַּצֶּ֥מֶר
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- nā wə·niw·wā·ḵə·ḥāh yō·mar Yah·weh ’im- ḥă·ṭā·’ê·ḵem yih·yū kaš·šā·nîm yal·bî·nū kaš·še·leḡ ’im- ya’·dî·mū ḵat·tō·w·lā‘ yih·yū kaṣ·ṣe·mer
verses.literal: Come now let us reason together says the LORD Though your sins are like scarlet they will be as white as snow though they are as red as crimson they will become like wool

verses.original: אִם־ תֹּאב֖וּ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃ ט֥וּב הָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: ’im- tō·ḇū ū·šə·ma‘·tem tō·ḵê·lū ṭūḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: If you are willing and obedient you will eat the best of the land

verses.original: וְאִם־ תְּמָאֲנ֖וּ וּמְרִיתֶ֑ם תְּאֻכְּל֔וּ חֶ֣רֶב כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- tə·mā·’ă·nū ū·mə·rî·ṯem tə·’uk·kə·lū ḥe·reḇ kî pî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: But if you resist and rebel you will be devoured by the sword For the mouth of the LORD has spoken

verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ נֶאֱמָנָ֑ה מְלֵאֲתִ֣י קִרְיָ֖ה הָיְתָ֣ה לְזוֹנָ֔ה מִשְׁפָּ֗ט צֶ֛דֶק יָלִ֥ין בָּ֖הּ וְעַתָּ֥ה מְרַצְּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh ne·’ĕ·mā·nāh mə·lê·’ă·ṯî qir·yāh hā·yə·ṯāh lə·zō·w·nāh miš·pāṭ ṣe·ḏeq yā·lîn bāh wə·‘at·tāh mə·raṣ·ṣə·ḥîm
verses.literal: [See] how the faithful . . . city has become a harlot She once was full of justice righteousness resided within her but now only murderers

verses.original: כַּסְפֵּ֖ךְ הָיָ֣ה לְסִיגִ֑ים סָבְאֵ֖ךְ מָה֥וּל בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kas·pêḵ hā·yāh lə·sî·ḡîm sā·ḇə·’êḵ mā·hūl bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: Your silver has become dross your fine wine is diluted with water

verses.original: שָׂרַ֣יִךְ סוֹרְרִ֗ים וְחַבְרֵי֙ גַּנָּבִ֔ים כֻּלּוֹ֙ אֹהֵ֣ב שֹׁ֔חַד וְרֹדֵ֖ף שַׁלְמֹנִ֑ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁפֹּ֔טוּ יָתוֹם֙ וְרִ֥יב אַלְמָנָ֖ה לֹֽא־ יָב֥וֹא אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: śā·ra·yiḵ sō·wr·rîm wə·ḥaḇ·rê gan·nā·ḇîm kul·lōw ’ō·hêḇ šō·ḥaḏ wə·rō·ḏêp̄ šal·mō·nîm lō yiš·pō·ṭū yā·ṯō·wm wə·rîḇ ’al·mā·nāh lō- yā·ḇō·w ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Your rulers are rebels friends of thieves They all love bribes and chasing after rewards They do not defend the fatherless and the plea of the widow never comes before them

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הָֽאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲבִ֖יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נְאֻ֤ם ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִצָּרַ֔י וְאִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵאוֹיְבָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·ḇîr yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um hō·w ’en·nā·ḥêm miṣ·ṣā·ray wə·’in·nā·qə·māh mê·’ō·wy·ḇāy
verses.literal: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts the Mighty One of Israel declares Ah I will be relieved of My foes and avenge Myself on My enemies

verses.original: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְאֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּבֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִךְ וְאָסִ֖ירָה כָּל־ בְּדִילָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·šî·ḇāh yā·ḏî ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·’eṣ·rōp̄ kab·bōr sî·ḡā·yiḵ wə·’ā·sî·rāh kāl- bə·ḏî·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: I will turn My hand against you I will thoroughly purge . . . your dross I will remove all your impurities

verses.original: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה שֹׁפְטַ֙יִךְ֙ כְּבָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה וְיֹעֲצַ֖יִךְ כְּבַתְּחִלָּ֑ה אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן יִקָּ֤רֵא לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר הַצֶּ֔דֶק נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃ קִרְיָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·šî·ḇāh šō·p̄ə·ṭa·yiḵ kə·ḇā·ri·šō·nāh wə·yō·‘ă·ṣa·yiḵ kə·ḇat·tə·ḥil·lāh ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yiq·qā·rê lāḵ ‘îr haṣ·ṣe·ḏeq ne·’ĕ·mā·nāh qir·yāh
verses.literal: I will restore your judges as at first and your counselors as at the beginning After that . . . you will be called the City of Righteousness the Faithful City

verses.original: צִיּ֖וֹן תִּפָּדֶ֑ה בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yō·wn tip·pā·ḏeh bə·miš·pāṭ wə·šā·ḇe·hā biṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Zion will be redeemed with justice her repentant ones with righteousness

verses.original: פֹּשְׁעִ֛ים וְחַטָּאִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְשֶׁ֧בֶר וְעֹזְבֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: pō·šə·‘îm wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm yaḥ·dāw wə·še·ḇer wə·‘ō·zə·ḇê Yah·weh yiḵ·lū
verses.literal: But rebels and sinners will together be shattered and those who forsake the LORD will perish

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מֵאֵילִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲמַדְתֶּ֑ם וְתַ֨חְפְּר֔וּ מֵהַגַּנּ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî yê·ḇō·šū mê·’ê·lîm ’ă·šer ḥă·maḏ·tem wə·ṯaḥ·pə·rū mê·hag·gan·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·ḥar·tem
verses.literal: Surely you will be ashamed of the sacred oaks - in which you have delighted you will be embarrassed by the gardens that you have chosen

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִֽהְי֔וּ כְּאֵלָ֖ה עָלֶ֑הָ נֹבֶ֣לֶת וּֽכְגַנָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃ מַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: kî ṯih·yū kə·’ê·lāh ‘ā·le·hā nō·ḇe·leṯ ū·ḵə·ḡan·nāh ’ă·šer- ’ên lāh ma·yim
verses.literal: For you will become like an oak whose leaves are withered like a garden - without water

verses.original: הֶחָסֹן֙ וְהָיָ֤ה לִנְעֹ֔רֶת וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לְנִיצ֑וֹץ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם וּבָעֲר֧וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו וְאֵ֥ין מְכַבֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: he·ḥā·sōn wə·hā·yāh lin·‘ō·reṯ ū·p̄ō·‘ă·lōw lə·nî·ṣō·wṣ šə·nê·hem ū·ḇā·‘ă·rū yaḥ·dāw wə·’ên mə·ḵab·beh
verses.literal: The strong man will become tinder and his work [will be] a spark both will burn together with no one to quench the flames
